name: Any other document
fullName: Photo resizer for any passport, visa or ID application
covers: National ID cards and driving licences
intro: Enter the photo rules from your application's official instructions: size in pixels or millimetres, DPI and the KB range. The tool crops, resizes and compresses your photo to match.

documents.label: Photo
documents.caption: optional
notes: The fields start at a common 35 × 45 mm size. Change them to match your instructions.
If the instructions give only pixels, switch to Pixels. If they give mm and DPI, keep mm.

source.label: The official instructions for your application

faqs.q: How do I resize a photo for a visa or ID card that isn't listed?
faqs.a: Find the photo rules in the application's instructions, enter the size and KB range on this page, position your face inside the guide and download the JPG.

faqs.q: What if the instructions only give a size in inches?
faqs.a: Multiply inches by 25.4 to get millimetres. For example, 2 × 2 inches is 50.8 × 50.8 mm.
